title: Horror OneBlock
description: OneBlock survival with horror mobs, dwellers, guns, shaders, and Create automation.
body:
# Horror OneBlock

**Horror OneBlock** is a Forge modpack built around a pre-made OneBlock world and a dark horror atmosphere.

Start on a single block and survive while terrifying creatures, dwellers, stalker entities, disturbing sounds, and psychological horror events make progression much more dangerous than normal OneBlock survival.

This modpack combines classic OneBlock gameplay with horror, combat, automation, shaders, and quality-of-life improvements.

## Features

- Pre-made **OneBlock world** included
- Multiple **horror mobs**, dwellers, and stalker entities
- Atmospheric **sound** and **shader** support
- **Guns** and combat-focused survival
- **Create** automation
- Storage and quality-of-life improvements
- Performance optimizations
- Designed for a creepy and challenging survival experience

## Included content

This pack focuses on horror-themed gameplay and includes:
- Horror mobs and dwellers
- Psychological horror messages / events
- OneBlock progression
- Create-based automation
- Weapon and survival systems
- Shader support
- Voice chat and extra immersion features

## How to play

After installing the modpack:

1. Open **Singleplayer**
2. Start the included world
3. Survive and progress through the OneBlock experience

## Important notes

- This modpack includes a **pre-made world**
- The included world may show an **experimental settings warning**
- This is normal and required for the map / world setup to function correctly

## Credits

I do not own the mods included in this modpack.  
All credit goes to the original mod creators and the creator(s) of the included OneBlock world.

This modpack is a curated combination of mods, configs, and a pre-made world for a complete horror-themed OneBlock experience.
